item.title: Davis Farmers Market — Sat Aug 29, 8:00 AM — Central Park
item.description:
Year-round at Central Park in downtown Davis, thousands gather each week to shop for what is grown, raised, and made locally at our markets. We are dedicated to bringing farmers right to your table, so we stay open rain or shine. Walk rows of stalls lined with an array of fruits and vegetables, including certified organic produce, choice meats, chicken, seafood, wine, local eggs and honey. Choose from a variety of fresh-baked goods, plants, flowers and gifts. Enjoy a picnic from one of our many food stands, made from market ingredients. See the vendor list here: https://www.davisfarmersmarket.org/our-sellers/ Farmers Market Hours Central Park: Saturdays 8a–1p (year-round), and Wednesdays 3p–6p (September through March); 4p–8p (April through August) UC Davis – North Quad: Wednesdays 10a–1:30p (fall and spring quarters) Sutter Davis Hospital: Thursdays 10a–1p (May through September) Sutter Medical Center, Sacramento: Thursdays 2:30p–5:30p
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note — Wed Nov 11, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering Update 8/14/25: **We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)
We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.
People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.
Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.
You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants

item.description:

If you have ever felt like you would like to learn a little more about how to defend yourself and your loved ones, and would like to get a little fitness training too, please join us! item.title: International Karaoke Night Series — Thu Aug 27, 6:30 PM — International House Davis
item.description:
Join us at the International Karaoke Summer Series, a high-energy celebration of music, culture, and community. Sing songs from around the world — from favorites from your home country to global hits and timeless classics. No karaoke experience required! Everyone is welcome! The evening is all about fun and connection, not performance. Come solo or with friends. Grab a drink, sing your heart out, cheer others on, hit the dance floor, or simply soak in the atmosphere in a welcoming, low pressure space. Discover music in different languages, meet new people, and take part in a joyful evening that brings cultures together through shared experience. Get your ticket and join us for a night where community is built one song at a time. Get your tickets at InternationalHouseDavis.org
Source: The Dirt

item.title: 21st National Juried Exhibition — Fri Aug 28, 12:00 PM — Axis Gallery
item.description: AXIS GALLERY 21st ANNUAL NATIONAL JURIED COMPETITION August 7–30, 2026 Second Saturday Reception August 8, 2026, 5–8 PM Axis Gallery presents the 21st Annual National Juried Competition, a group exhibition featuring works selected by juror Sharon Butler, founder of Two Coats of Paint. The exhibition includes works by artists from around the country in a variety of mediums. JUROR’S STATEMENT The Axis Gallery received 658 submissions to an open call, and I could have selected five exhibitions instead of one without feeling professionally compromised. Narrowing such a high- quality profusion down to a single hang was a real challenge. Whereas traditional thematic trawls tend to be self-limiting, open calls like this one afford the juror no circumscribing guidance – only that of quality on the terms artists set for themselves.
